svg.title: One decode step on SIRCL ring sessions
svg.desc: A four-Spark tensor-parallel group runs one decode step. Every rank holds the same input rows: each running sequence's newest token and the draft tokens from the previous step. In every layer, attention and the MLP or expert block each produce a partial result per rank that a SIRCL all-reduce sums. The LM head's vocabulary slices are joined by a SIRCL all-gather, the drafts are verified, and the draft model proposes the next step's tokens. A SIRCL all-reduce is one kernel launch: the kernel stages the input in a pinned host arena and rings a doorbell, the progress thread writes each peer's stripe and flag over RDMA, relays forward to Sparks that share no cable, and the kernel sums every rank's values in rank order once all flags arrive, so every rank holds identical bits. NCCL is off.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
